Treatments

Everything we do,
and who it is for.

Each page tells you what the treatment does, how many sessions it usually takes, what it costs, and — the part most clinics leave out — who it is not right for. Every treatment starts with a consultation.

Skin6 Hair3 Wellness4
01 — Category

Skin

Pigmentation, texture, laxity and tone. Assessed first, then treated with the device or protocol that matches your skin — not the one we happen to own.

6 treatments

Laser

CO₂ Fractional Laser

A resurfacing laser that makes controlled micro-injuries to trigger skin renewal and collagen, softening scars, pores, texture and fine lines.

On consultation 45–60 minutes, plus numbing time
Explore→
Aesthetics

HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound)

Focused ultrasound delivered beneath the skin to support collagen and improve firmness, lift and facial contour — without surgery or injectables.

On consultation 60–90 minutes
Explore→
Dermatology

Chemical Peel

A controlled exfoliating treatment that removes damaged surface cells to reveal smoother, brighter skin — with the strength matched to you.

On consultation 30–45 minutes
Explore→
Dermatology

Non-Invasive Melasma Treatment

A gentle, non-surgical program to improve melasma, dark patches and uneven tone — tailored to your skin, with minimal downtime.

On consultation 30–45 minutes
Explore→
Aesthetics

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma)

Uses platelet-rich plasma prepared from your own blood to support skin renewal, and to complement scalp and hair-restoration programs.

On consultation 45–60 minutes
Explore→
Dermatology

Warts Removal — Per Area

Targeted removal of suitable superficial skin growths within a defined area, with the method chosen for the type, size and location.

On consultation 15–30 minutes per area
Explore→
02 — Category

Hair

Scalp health and hair restoration. The scalp is assessed before anything is prescribed, and a regrowth plan is built around the cause, not a product.

3 treatments

Scalp

Scalp Anti-Dandruff Treatment

A deep-cleansing treatment that clears buildup, oil and flakes and helps soothe an itchy, dry or dandruff-prone scalp.

On consultation 45–60 minutes
Explore→
Hair Restoration

Hair Growth with PDRN

A follicle-stimulation scalp therapy using PDRN to support a healthier scalp environment and the appearance of thinning hair, as part of a regrowth plan.

On consultation 45–60 minutes
Explore→
Hair Restoration

Needle-Free Hair Growth with Exosomes

Topical, needle-free exosome scalp care that supports a healthier scalp environment and the appearance of thinning hair — no injections, no microneedling.

On consultation 45–60 minutes
Explore→
03 — Category

Wellness

Body contouring, IV wellness and recovery. Every drip and device is screened for suitability first, and nothing is run to a fixed menu.

4 treatments

Wellness

Glutathione IV Drip

An intravenous wellness drip containing glutathione, an antioxidant involved in the body's natural antioxidant processes. Assessed before administration.

On consultation 30–60 minutes
Explore→
Body

Exilis Treatment

A non-invasive treatment using energy-based technology to heat targeted tissue for skin tightening and gentle body contouring.

On consultation 30–45 minutes per area
Explore→
Body

Radio Frequency (RF)

Non-invasive radio frequency that warms the deeper layers of skin to support tightening and gentle contouring, on the face or body.

On consultation 30–45 minutes per area
Explore→
Body

Barbie Slimming Arms

A targeted arm-contouring program designed for a slimmer, more defined upper arm, with the method customised to your body goals.

On consultation 45–60 minutes per session
Explore→
Not sure which one

That is what the consultation is for.

Come in and we will tell you what will work on your skin or scalp — including when the answer is none of the above.
